name: Part 1: Slack Workbot shows Salesforce Account details when you post a URL in Slack
description:
1. Workbot will monitor the Slack channel and activate every time a Salesforce Account URL is mentioned. 
2. Workbot will prompt you to choose between viewing your Cases or Opportunities related to that Account. 
3. Choose the number and where you want to start with in your list of cases/opportunities.  Workbot will fetch them for you and you can view them in Slack.

**Notes**
- This recipe works with 2 other recipes. Clone and run [Print List of Salesforce Cases with start_index and print_count by Account](https://www.workato.com/recipes/382662-part-2-1-print-list-of-salesforce-cases-with-start_index-and-print_count-by-account) and [Get List of Salesforce Opportunities related to Account with index](https://www.workato.com/recipes/382660-part-2-2-get-list-of-salesforce-opportunities-related-to-account-with-index) to use this recipe.
- Workbot must be invited to Slack channels before it can post messages in those channels.
